artist.context: Head and shoulders of a person in a beret, with a paintbrush raised beside them. Used for art classes, creative portfolios, painting workshops, gallery apps and profile roles for illustrators.

astronaut.context: Figure wearing a rounded space helmet with a wide visor. Fits space and science topics, kids' learning apps, rocket launches, exploration themes and fun avatar choices.

baby.context: Round baby face with a single curl of hair on top. Used in parenting apps, baby changing room signs, childcare services, nursery shops and family plans.

bride.context: Person wearing a long veil that falls to the shoulders. Used on wedding websites, event planners, bridal shops, guest lists and invitation cards.

builder.context: Person in a hard hat, drawn from the shoulders up. Used for construction companies, contractor profiles, site safety notices, home renovation apps and pages that are under construction.

cashier.context: Person standing behind a cash register. Fits point-of-sale screens, retail staff roles, checkout counters, shop opening hours and payment desks.

chef.context: Person wearing a tall, puffed chef's hat. Used in recipe apps, restaurant menus, cooking classes, kitchen staff roles and food delivery listings.

child.context: Small stick figure with both arms raised, as if jumping or playing. Used for kids' zones, playgrounds, family tickets, school apps and child age groups in forms.

contact-card.context: Card with a portrait and text lines, set in front of a second card. Used for contact lists, business cards, vCards, address book entries and ID or member cards.

couple.context: Two people side by side with a small heart above them. Used in dating apps, relationship status, wedding planning, couples' plans and anniversary reminders.

crowd.context: Several heads and shoulders packed together in rows. Fits audience counts, event attendance, public spaces, population data and busy or crowded indicators.

designer.context: Person shown next to a vector pen nib. Used for design roles, creative teams, UI and UX portfolios, freelancer profiles and design tool menus.

detective.context: Figure in a wide-brimmed hat holding a magnifying glass. Used for investigations, fraud checks, mystery games, inspect or audit tools and private browsing themes.

doctor.context: Person with a stethoscope hanging around the neck. Used for booking appointments, telehealth, clinic staff pages, medical records and health insurance apps.

elderly.context: Older person with a bent posture walking with a cane. Used for senior discounts, priority seating signs, aged care services, retirement planning and accessibility info.

family.context: Two adults standing behind a smaller child. Used for family plans, household accounts, parental settings, family tickets and shared memberships.

farmer.context: Person in a wide straw hat, seen from the shoulders up. Used for agriculture, farm-to-table produce, rural services, local markets and gardening or crop apps.

firefighter.context: Person in a firefighter's helmet with a raised front shield. Used for fire services, emergency contacts, fire safety training, rescue teams and incident reporting.

gender-neutral.context: Restroom-style pictogram of a person whose lower half is split into a trouser leg and a skirt. Used on all-gender toilet signs, inclusive forms, gender options and facility maps.

groom.context: Man in a top hat with a bow tie at his collar. Used on wedding sites, guest lists, formal events, menswear shops and invitation cards.

hand-raised.context: Stick figure with one arm held high. Used to raise a hand in video calls and classrooms, ask a question, volunteer, vote or get someone's attention.

handshake.context: Two hands clasped in a handshake. Used for deals, partnerships, agreements, onboarding welcomes, trust badges and business networking.

judge.context: Person wearing a curled judge's wig. Used for legal services, court dates, law firms, dispute resolution, verdicts and judging panels in contests.

king.context: Bearded figure wearing a crown with pointed tips. Used for royalty and history topics, chess pieces, premium or top-tier badges, leaderboards and fairy-tale games.

lifeguard.context: Person holding a round life ring. Used for pool and beach safety signs, swimming lessons, water rescue services and holiday resort guides.

man.context: Restroom-style pictogram of a man with a round head and straight legs. Used on men's toilet signs, changing rooms, gender options in forms and demographic charts.

mechanic.context: Person holding a spanner at their side. Used for car repair shops, maintenance services, technician bookings, service centres and fix or repair settings.

musician.context: Person with a musical note floating beside them. Used for artist profiles, band pages, music lessons, concert listings and singer or performer roles.

ninja.context: Masked face with a headband whose loose ends trail out behind. Used in games, martial arts clubs, stealth or incognito modes and playful expert badges.

nurse.context: Person in a nurse's cap marked with a cross. Used for hospital staff, patient care, home care services, clinic appointments and medical help desks.

person-running.context: Side-on figure mid-stride with arms swinging, running fast. Used for fitness trackers, workouts, marathons, sports clubs, emergency exits and hurry or quick actions.

person-standing.context: Front-facing figure standing upright with arms at the sides. Used as a generic human symbol for body metrics, maps, accessibility info, standing reminders and people counts.

person-walking.context: Side-on figure taking a step forward. Used for walking directions, step counters, pedestrian routes, travel time on maps and activity tracking.

photographer.context: Person holding a camera up to their face. Used for photographer profiles, photo credits, photoshoot bookings, press passes and camera or gallery sections.

pilot.context: Person in a peaked cap with a wing badge on the front. Used for airlines, flight crew, aviation training, travel bookings and captain roles.

pirate.context: Figure in a tricorn hat with an eye patch. Used for pirate-themed games, kids' parties, treasure hunts, adventure stories and costume shops.

police.context: Person wearing a police officer's peaked cap with a badge. Used for law enforcement contacts, reporting a crime, security staff, emergency numbers and safety apps.

prince.context: Young figure wearing a small crown on short hair. Used in fairy-tale stories, kids' games, royalty topics, party themes and playful avatars.

princess.context: Figure with long hair falling to the shoulders, wearing a tiara. Used in fairy-tale stories, children's games, party themes, royalty topics and playful avatars.

profile.context: Upright card showing a portrait above a name line. Used for user profile pages, about me sections, account details, ID badges and member directories.

programmer.context: Person seated behind an open laptop that shows code brackets. Used for developer roles, engineering teams, coding courses, tech jobs and software help pages.

queen.context: Figure with long hair wearing a pointed crown. Used for royalty and history topics, chess pieces, top-rank badges, leaderboards and fairy-tale games.

scientist.context: Person beside a laboratory flask. Used for research teams, science education, lab results, experiments, chemistry lessons and biotech or pharma roles.

soldier.context: Person in a rounded combat helmet marked with a star. Used for military and defence topics, veterans' services, army recruitment, history lessons and strategy games.

student.context: Person wearing a square graduation cap. Used for student accounts, school and university portals, online courses, graduation events and education discounts.

superhero.context: Figure in a flowing cape with a star on the chest. Used for comic and kids' themes, achievement badges, power users, hero sections and game characters.

teacher.context: Person pointing at a small board beside them. Used for teacher accounts, tutoring services, online classes, lessons, training sessions and presentations.

team.context: Three people standing in a row, one behind the next. Used for team pages, workspace members, staff directories, group projects and shared work tools.

user.context: Simple head and shoulders outline of a person. Used for account menus, sign in and profile links, author fields, member lists and any single-person placeholder.

user-circle.context: Head and shoulders of a person inside a circle. Used for round profile avatars, account buttons in top bars, default profile pictures and user menus.

user-group.context: Three people side by side, the middle one taller and in front. Used for groups, communities, team spaces, audience segments and shared workspaces.

user-square.context: Head and shoulders of a person inside a rounded square. Used for square account pictures, profile placeholders, contact photos and user cards in lists.

users.context: Two people, one standing slightly behind the other. Used for member lists, shared access, friends, contacts, multi-user plans and user management screens.

waiter.context: Person in a bow tie beside a covered serving dish with a small handle on top. Used for restaurants, table service, room service, catering, hotel staff and food ordering.

wizard.context: Figure in a tall pointed hat with a long beard. Used for fantasy games, magic themes, setup wizards, step-by-step guides, auto-fix tools and storybook content.

woman.context: Restroom-style pictogram of a woman in a dress. Used on women's toilet signs, changing rooms, gender options in forms and demographic charts.

worker.context: Person in a shirt and tie, drawn from the shoulders up. Used for employees, office staff, job listings, HR tools, business accounts and professional profiles.
